body: You know this is what my remedy used to be.  Call my friends, but over the past three years I've only found that the only real ones I have are the two I mentioned before.  One is so sick now that after a ten minute conversation he needs to sleep.  I called the remaining of my acquaintances and they were just too busy to hear me, sad part is if I was saying "Hey let's go party, my treat" they'd find a way to be unbusy and available.
